facts.claim: The creator description says there are more than 80 squishies to collect, including Dumplings, Needoh, and Keycaps.

first_10_minutes: Start by tapping squishies and confirm that the coin counter increases.
Find the blind-box interaction and open a box when the game makes one available.
Inspect the squishy you receive and begin learning the collection view.
Notice that trading and upgrades are separate progression paths; their exact costs and unlock timing are not documented in the public description.
core_loop: Open blind boxes to discover rare squishies.
Trade with players to earn XP.
Grow a collection drawn from more than 80 squishies.
progression_path: Learn the tapping action and establish a steady coin-gaining rhythm.
Add squishies through blind boxes without assuming undocumented rarity odds.
Use trading as the confirmed XP path.
Compare the available luck and squish-power upgrades before choosing where to progress.
common_mistakes: Ignoring trading even though the creator identifies it as an XP source.
Treating unverified rarity odds, values, codes, or upgrade costs as official.
Assuming coins buy blind boxes; the public description confirms both systems but does not state the exact payment relationship.

faq.question: What can you upgrade?
faq.answer: Luck and squish powers are confirmed upgrade categories.

faq.question: How many squishies are there?
faq.answer: The creator description says there are more than 80.
